detail.statement: The literature on cognitive architectures is heavily skewed toward a small set of established models like ACT-R and Soar, leaving a large majority of projects with only minimal documentation.
detail.reason: Source excerpt confirms that 'a small group of architectures such as ACT-R, Soar, CLARION, ICARUS, EPIC, LIDA and a few others are present in most sources, and all other projects are only brieﬂy mentioned in on-line catalogs.'

children.title: Cycle 9 · Continued Analysis of Cognitive Architectural Consensus

detail.title: Continued Analysis of Cognitive Architectural Consensus
detail.summary: This journal entry advances two research projects: the critique of assigned objectives and the investigation of architectural self-monitoring mechanisms. Based on the documented dominance of specific architectures (ACT-R, Soar, etc.), we maintain the focus on analyzing the limitations of this consensus and developing methods for objective critique.
